headline: 影剧双热：泥面人领跑，幻视任务首播
summary: 本周影市由《泥面人》《克拉拉与太阳》等新片领跑，新剧《幻视任务》首播、《侠探杰克》持续热播；《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》等待映大片也拉高期待。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《泥面人》《克拉拉与太阳》《街头霸王》等本周受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: Clayface, Klara and the Sun, and Street Fighter draw attention this week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《雅嘎疑云》《幻视任务》本周上线。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Yaga Mystery and Vision Quest launch this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《侠探杰克》《水晶湖》《魔女嘉莉》《菜鸟老警》持续升温。
industryHighlights.en: Hot series: Reacher, Crystal Lake, Carrie, and The Rookie keep gaining momentum.

industryHighlights.text: 待映片单：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《哥斯拉-0.0》等拉满期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Avengers 5, Dune 3, and Godzilla -0.0 fuel anticipation.

headlineEn: Film & TV buzz: Clayface leads, Vision Quest debuts
summaryEn: This week’s movie slate is led by Clayface and Klara and the Sun, while new series Vision Quest premieres and Reacher stays hot; upcoming Avengers 5 and Dune 3 also boost anticipation.
